posts.title: Webb's View of M64
posts.lead: Sometimes where Hubble finds darkness, Webb sees light. An example is today’s composite images of Messier 64 (M64), a nearby spiral galaxy of many names.

posts.title: NASA’s New X-59 Test Pilot Gets Behind Controls for Ground Test
posts.lead: This summer, NASA test pilot Mike Lippert powered up the X‑59 cockpit for the first time, running the aircraft’s engines on the ground during a key step in his months of preparation and training to fly the experimental aircraft.

posts.title: NASA Field-Tests AI Fleet Capability for Science, Exploration
posts.lead: In this field test, a fleet of three robots worked together, and researchers assessed the fleet’s ability to act like an independent science team.
